argumentMap.belief: A returning reader can see when the policy last changed.
The reader knows PostHog records the pages they view, the site that sent them, their browser and device type, and the links they click, and stores nothing on their device to do it.

The reader understands PostHog receives their IP address, counts them under an ID that changes daily rather than their name, keeps the data in the United States, and that nothing is recorded as a replay, sold or used for ads.

The reader knows each other service a visit can touch and its one job: Cloudflare hosts the site, Google serves the fonts and video thumbnails, YouTube plays a video only after they press play, Amazon sees affiliate-link clicks and may set its own cookies, and the store runs on Fourthwall.

The reader knows a message sent by email or the contact form (name, email address, message) goes into Seth's own CRM and is used only to reply, that the form is checked for spam by Cloudflare once they start filling it in, and that if the CRM is unreachable the form emails the message to Seth through Resend.
The reader can find what the site stores in their browser on the cookies page and ask anything at support@bytemycache.com.

contract.maximalHonestPromise: A visitor can see exactly what byteMyCache records, that analytics stores nothing on their device, and every outside service a visit touches, with nothing overstated.
contract.signedThesis: byteMyCache counts visits with PostHog without storing anything on your device or tying them to your name, and names every outside service your visit touches so you can decide for yourself.

lensReview.rationale: It dates the policy for a returning reader.
It answers the reader's first question with the actual scope of tracking.
It resolves whether the record identifies them or travels further, without overstating anonymity.
It names every outside party a reader could otherwise discover only by inspecting traffic, and meets Amazon's disclosure requirement.
It covers the one case where the reader hands over identifying information, and every service that message touches.
It routes the reader to the cookies page and the contact address.
